LESSON: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension, part of Strand 7 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why are careers important? 2.How can we ensure we summarise information accurately?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. summarise the key points from texts on careers and professions,

2. read the points to the class for peer review,

3. listen to a video recording based on the theme,

4. work jointly to identify vocabulary related to the theme from the video recording,

5. infer the meaning of vocabulary from context,

6. work with peers to prepare a mind map on the various careers and professions and display. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. summarise the key points from texts on careers and professions,
2. read the points to the class for peer review,
3. listen to a video recording based on the theme,
4. work jointly to identify vocabulary related to the theme from the video recording,
5. infer the meaning of vocabulary from context,
6. work with peers to prepare a mind map on the various careers and professions and display. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: This is promoted as the learner explore views when inferring the meaning of

vocabulary from context.

● Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner shows concerted effort when working with peers to prepare a mind map on

the various careers and professions and display.

40

Values:
● Unity: This is developed as the learner harmoniously works with peers as they share information and peer review each

other’s work.

● Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner takes up group roles to complete a task.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: This is addressed as the learner interacts with digital texts and audio recordings to access information based on

the theme.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate and connect the concept of careers to their learning of different occupations in Social Studies.
